question: List the course IDs and titles of all courses in the 'Computer Science' department.
query: SELECT course_id, title FROM course WHERE dept_name = 'Computer Science'

question: List the names and salaries of instructors in the 'Finance' department who earn more than 70000.
query: SELECT name, salary FROM instructor WHERE dept_name = 'Finance' AND salary > 70000

question: List the student IDs, names, and total credits of students who have at least 60 total credits.
query: SELECT id, name, total_credits FROM student WHERE total_credits >= 60

question: List the course IDs, titles, and credits of all 4-credit courses outside the 'Computer Science' department.
query: SELECT course_id, title, credits FROM course WHERE credits = 4 AND dept_name <> 'Computer Science'

question: List each unique instructor name and course title pair for courses taught by that instructor.
query: SELECT DISTINCT i.name AS instructor_name, c.title AS course_title FROM instructor AS i JOIN teaches AS t ON i.id = t.id JOIN course AS c ON t.course_id = c.course_id

question: List the student name, course title, and grade for every course enrollment in Fall 2009.
query: SELECT s.name AS student_name, c.title AS course_title, tk.grade FROM student AS s JOIN takes AS tk ON s.id = tk.id JOIN course AS c ON tk.course_id = c.course_id WHERE tk.semester = 'Fall' AND tk.year = 2009

question: List the student IDs and names of students who took a specific course offering taught by instructor '10101'.
query: SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name FROM student AS s JOIN takes AS tk ON s.id = tk.id JOIN teaches AS te ON tk.course_id = te.course_id AND tk.sec_id = te.sec_id AND tk.semester = te.semester AND tk.year = te.year WHERE te.id = '10101'

question: List each course ID and title together with the ID and title of its prerequisite course.
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.title AS course_title, p.course_id AS prerequisite_id, p.title AS prerequisite_title FROM prereq AS pr JOIN course AS c ON pr.course_id = c.course_id JOIN course AS p ON pr.prereq_id = p.course_id

question: For every course, show its course ID, title, and number of distinct enrolled students, including courses with zero students.
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS num_students FROM course AS c LEFT JOIN takes AS t ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.title

question: For every department, show its name and number of instructors, including departments with zero instructors.
query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS num_instructors FROM department AS d LEFT JOIN instructor AS i ON d.dept_name = i.dept_name GROUP BY d.dept_name

question: Show each department name and its average instructor salary, but only for departments whose average salary is above 70000.
query: SELECT dept_name, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM instructor GROUP BY dept_name HAVING AVG(salary) > 70000

question: List the student IDs and names of students who have taken at least 3 distinct courses, along with the number of distinct courses taken.
query: SELECT s.id, s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.course_id) AS num_courses FROM student AS s JOIN takes AS t ON s.id = t.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.course_id) >= 3

question: Show the top 3 courses by number of distinct enrolled students, returning course ID, title, and student count in descending count order; break ties by course ID ascending.
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS num_students FROM course AS c LEFT JOIN takes AS t ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.title ORDER BY num_students DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 3

question: Show the 5 highest-paid instructors, returning instructor ID, name, and salary in descending salary order; break ties by instructor ID ascending.
query: SELECT id, name, salary FROM instructor ORDER BY salary DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5

question: List all departments with their budgets from highest budget to lowest; break ties by department name ascending.
query: SELECT dept_name, budget FROM department ORDER BY budget DESC, dept_name ASC

question: Show the top 3 students by total credits, returning student ID, name, and total credits in descending credit order; break ties by student ID ascending.
query: SELECT id, name, total_credits FROM student ORDER BY total_credits DESC, id ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the course IDs and titles of courses that have no student enrollments.
query: SELECT c.course_id, c.title FROM course AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM takes AS t WHERE t.course_id = c.course_id)

question: List the instructor IDs and names of instructors who taught at least one course in both 2009 and 2010.
query: SELECT i.id, i.name FROM instructor AS i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teaches AS t1 WHERE t1.id = i.id AND t1.year = 2009) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teaches AS t2 WHERE t2.id = i.id AND t2.year = 2010)

question: List the names of departments that have no instructors.
query: SELECT d.dept_name FROM department AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instructor AS i WHERE i.dept_name = d.dept_name)

question: List the student IDs and names of students who have taken at least one course outside their own department.
query: SELECT s.id, s.name FROM student AS s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM takes AS t JOIN course AS c ON t.course_id = c.course_id WHERE t.id = s.id AND c.dept_name <> s.dept_name)
